heading: Engineer by trade, systems thinker by habit.
body:
I'm a DevOps and cloud engineer with a full-stack developer's instincts. I like owning problems end to end: sketching the architecture, provisioning it with Terraform, wiring up the CI/CD, and writing the application code that runs on top.

I've helped teams migrate monoliths to Kubernetes, cut cloud bills without cutting reliability, and turn week-long release cycles into multiple deploys a day.

Outside work I write about system design, contribute to open-source tooling, and tinker with my homelab cluster.
highlights: Full-stack apps: React, Node, Python, Flutter
